name: Hugh Mclachlan — marriage in 1845, Kilninian, Argyll, Scotland
researcher_question: When and where did Hugh Mclachlan marry Catharine Muir, the parents of Neil (born 1850) and James (born 1852), both christened in Campbeltown, Argyll?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-3.csv row 23, hint-samples.csv row 792, flag adds_marriage, confidence 3). Resolved 2026-10-15 (#3344): true match (outcome 1). The 1845 Kilninian marriage is kept. The 1861 census of Campbeltown (ark:/61903/1:1:VB78-JSC) gives the widowed Cathrine's elder daughters Flora and Annie as born at Tobermory, in Kilninian and Kilmore parish, about 1847 and 1849; the 1851 census (ark:/61903/1:1:VYYQ-ZGH) and James's marriage (ark:/61903/1:1:XSF1-FGNL) identify the family. Neither spouse was born on Mull (Hugh Midlothian, Catherine Saddell). Decided from FamilySearch indexes; no page image read.
